item.description: Claude (3.7 Sonnet) My best friend for coding questions. Not as good as GPT models at actually explaining what to do, but noticeably better with code. The limits even with the pro version are extremely frustrating though.

item.title: Perfectionism
item.description: A great reason not to start something. I am trying to kick the habit of being a perfectionist. Perfectionism is counterproductive. If you only want to make something perfect, you’ll probably never start.
